overview.mechanism: Inhibits URAT1-mediated urate reabsorption in proximal renal tubules, increasing urinary urate excretion.
uses: Urate-lowering treatment studied in hyperuricemia with or without gout; verify the Philippine-approved indication.

paragraphs.text: Clinical studies reviewed in 2021 reported serum-urate lowering in mild-to-moderate renal impairment. This evidence does not establish prevention of CKD progression, nor does it define a dialysis regimen.

Serum-urate lowering, gout outcomes and hard kidney outcomes are different endpoints. A dose schedule for advanced CKD should come from the current product label rather than extrapolation from the mechanism.

sources.citation: Dotinurad: a novel selective urate reabsorption inhibitor for the treatment of hyperuricemia and gout. PubMed PMID: 33926357.

revision_log.change: Source-linked descriptive overview and clinical evidence; no new unsupported dose recommendation or inferred dialysis schedule.
